## What happened Every pm-ops Daily Release since 2026-11-11 failed at **Reconcile durable release intent** with: ``` Error: Malformed candidate receipt ``` Latest example: https://github.com/unbraind/pm-ops/actions/runs/43186100514. The release-rerun sweep skips it each hour because it is not a merge-wait timeout. ## Cause `parseCandidateReceipt` in `scripts/release-continuation.ts` requires the bot PR body to end with the receipt's closing `\n-->`: ```ts if (parts.length !== 2 || !parts[1].endsWith("\n-->")) throw new Error("Malformed candidate receipt"); ``` On release PR #265 (closed), two review bots appended text after the receipt: **Sourcery** ("## Summary by Sourcery …") and **cubic** (""). The receipt itself was intact. Text after it made the whole repository's release preparation refuse. A scan of all fleet repositories' bot PRs found only #265 affected today. Any repository where these bots edit a release PR description can hit the same failure. ## Repaired for now I trimmed #265's body back to end at the receipt (the bots' text removed). With that body, `parseCandidateReceipt` returns artifact 13861624524 for version 2026.11.11. ## Expected - **Bound the parse by the receipt's own terminator.** Read exactly from the marker to its first `\n-->` and ignore text after it, as text before it is already ignored. Keep refusing two markers, a missing terminator and invalid JSON, so the record stays strict while edits outside it are harmless. - **Or keep the receipt out of reach.** Store it where review bots don't write, for example a bot-authored PR comment, a check-run output or a git ref, and read it from there. - **Tests that fail on revert:** - must-allow: a receipt followed by a Sourcery or cubic summary; - must-refuse: two markers, a truncated terminator, and a JSON body altered inside the block. --- ### GitHub comments (1) > **@coderabbitai[bot]** (2026-11-12T12:11:32Z) > > > > >
